title: Signature 26 · Hourglass SSBBW · Khokhloma · Snowy Birch
prompt:
Subject: ONE Black woman in her early 40s, long curls with a delicate gold tiara.

Physique: THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH, blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, not brown, her face the same deep tone with natural highlights and clearly defined features, not flat. Hourglass SSBBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits, around 500 pounds — an overwhelmingly colossal bust, enormous round hips wider than a normal woman's whole torso and flaring far beyond the shoulders, gigantic soft thighs, very thick soft arms, and a sharply cinched waist that stays clearly visible between them, with a soft rounded belly below the waistline that does not hide the waist. Huge, heavy, soft, unmistakably hourglass, not a plus-size model, not a shapeless round body, dominating the frame.

Body Art: Full body Russian Khokhloma painting painted directly on bare skin, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception. A high-gloss gold ground densely painted with swirling black and red grass curls, red rowan berries, and strawberries. The swirls spread wide across the colossal bust and hips and narrow across the cinched waistline. No borders, no bands. Densely filled with no plain skin, covering the shoulders and arms completely down to the wrists and the legs down to the ankles.

Pose: Standing facing the camera in a relaxed contrapposto, her weight on one leg so that enormous hip juts far outward, the other heel lifted, arms hanging relaxed slightly away from the body.

Footwear: Extremely high red lacquer platform stiletto mules. Nails: extra long almond, red with gold tips.

Background & Lighting: A snowy birch forest on a bright winter morning, white snow and pale trunks, the background much lighter than her body, soft low sunlight carving the deep inward curve of the waist and the huge curves of the bust and hips, making the gold ground gleam, bright highlights on every glossy curve. Extreme high-gloss finish. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
